concerns.text: T005a (validate_contracts.py) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T006 and T007 (schema definitions) existing before execution. The task description states: 'Requires T006 and T007 to exist before this script is written or executed. NOT Parallel with schema definition tasks.' The [P] tag is incorrect and misleading; this task must be serial after T006/T007.

T008d-1, T008d-2, and T008d-3 are all marked [P] (parallel-safe) but have explicit serial dependencies defined in their descriptions. T008d-2 depends on T008c. T008d-3 depends on T008d-1 and T008d-2. The [P] tags on these tasks are incorrect as they cannot run in parallel with each or their predecessors.
T014c is marked [P] but depends on T014 and T014b. The description states: 'CRITICAL: T014c cannot be executed until T014 and T014b are complete.' This violates the parallel-safe constraint.
T015 is marked [P] but depends on T013, T014, T014b, T016a, and T016b. The description states: 'CRITICAL: T015 cannot be executed until T013 is complete.' This violates the parallel-safe constraint.
T017 is marked [P] but depends on T015 (which exposes counts) and T013, T014. The description states: 'This task MUST run after T013, T014, T015'. This violates the parallel-safe constraint.

T021-2 is marked [P] but depends on T021-1. The description states: 'This task depends on T021-1. Note: Removed [P] tag to reflect serial dependency.' However, the task list still shows `[P]` next to T021-2. The tag must be removed.

T022a-2 is marked [P] but depends on T022a-1. The description states: 'This task depends on T022a-1. Note: Removed [P] tag to reflect serial dependency.' However, the task list still shows `[P]` next to T022a-2. The tag must be removed.
T025 is marked [P] but depends on T024. The description states: 'Requirement: Dependency: Depends on T024.' This violates the parallel-safe constraint.

T027 is marked [P] but depends on T022a-2, T022b, T023, T024, T029, T030. The description states: 'Requirement: Execution Order: This task MUST run AFTER T029... and T024'. This violates the parallel-safe constraint.
T033 is marked [P] but depends on T027, T030, T031. The description states: 'Requirement: Dependency: Depends on T027, T030, T031.' This violates the parallel-safe constraint.
